info.name: LastLink live TfL manual smoke
info.description: One internal live request. Set arriveBy to a future explicit-offset timestamp. Server must have JOURNEY_DATA_MODE=live and a private TFL_APP_KEY. Never put credentials in Postman. A response is not proof of passenger readiness.

exec: if (!/(?:Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$/.test(pm.variables.get('arriveBy') || '') || !pm.variables.get('arriveBy') || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(pm.variables.get('arriveBy'))) || Date.parse(pm.variables.get('arriveBy')) <= Date.now()) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set arriveBy to a future explicit-offset timestamp before sending.'); }

pm.test('Live station-only response', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.dataMode).to.equal('live'); pm.expect(b.stationOnly).to.equal(true); pm.expect(['viable','tight','not_viable','unable_to_verify']).to.include(b.status); });
